title: VinculoDiscentesCollection
description: Contract for GET /api/vinculo_discentes on the SIGAA API (api-unifesspa, API Platform 3.3). Hydra/JSON-LD collection, one member per vínculo (matrícula). Designed jointly by Uni+ and the SIGAA API team; the Uni+ Anti-Corruption Layer mirrors this shape. Grain: one active/known graduation (Ensino G) enrollment per member — the same CPF may appear in multiple members.

hydra:view.description: Pagination view. Mirrors the existing status_discentes envelope.

VinculoDiscente.description: A single graduation enrollment (vínculo discente). Natural key: idDiscente (the SIGAA PK id_discente). matricula is an attribute and is NOT unique — validated against the source, the same matrícula value occurs for distinct people.

@id.description: Hydra IRI. Path uses idDiscente as the resource identifier.

idDiscente.description: SIGAA enrollment PK (public.discente.id_discente). Unique and stable — the natural key of the record and the consumer's upsert key.

matricula.description: Enrollment number (SIGAA matrícula). Attribute, NOT a unique key (the same value occurs for distinct people in the source). Serialized as a string to preserve leading zeros and avoid bigint precision loss.

cpf.description: Person CPF, 11 digits, UNMASKED (required as the person identifier for the downstream double-bond check). SENSITIVE (LGPD): transported over TLS only; the consumer encrypts at rest and masks in logs.

nome.description: Civil name of the person. Carried for display/audit; the load-bearing identifiers are cpf and matricula.

nivel.description: Academic level. V1 syncs graduation only; expected value 'G'.

curso.description: Course, identified by id (id_curso) + nome, plus the e-MEC code for external cross-referencing. The SIGAA-internal course code is omitted: it means nothing outside the institution.

codigoEmec.description: Course code in the MEC registry (e-MEC). Identifies the course outside the university and is what allows cross-referencing it with MEC data. Null for a course that has not registered one (1 of 131 today). Carried as a string: it is an identifier, not a quantity.

unidade.description: Academic unit responsible for the course (public.curso.id_unidade). Usually an institute, but not always — some courses hang directly off a campus. Null for a course with no unit recorded (1,004 of 27,267 vínculos today).

situacao.description: Enrollment status, mirrored from StatusDiscente. Reflected as-is by the consumer.

id.description: StatusDiscente id from the closed vocabulary (see /api/status_discentes). Restricted to the 13 statuses that denote a real vínculo: the endpoint guard never emits DESCONHECIDO (-1), NÃO CADASTRADO (10), PENDENTE DE CADASTRO (13) or PRÉ CADASTRO (15).

situacaoVinculo.description: Vínculo situation code carried by StatusDiscente.situacao_vinculo (≤4 chars), when present.

dateRequest.description: Source-side generation timestamp of the response row (house style, same as status_discentes). Format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.
